clusters.title: Delivery Partner Unavailability & Canceled Orders
clusters.summary: Users report that orders stay pending for over an hour before being automatically cancelled without support explanation.

clusters.title: Wallet Refund Withholding & Non-responsive Support
clusters.summary: Cancelled order amounts are credited to in-app wallet rather than original payment methods with no customer support bot resolution.

clusters.title: Errand & Item Pick-and-Drop Flexibility
clusters.summary: Long-term users still appreciate the peer-to-peer parcel courier feature when local riders are available.

opportunities.title: Decentralized Peer Courier with Escrow Instant Refunds
opportunities.pitch: A hyper-local B2C parcel courier guaranteeing immediate bank refunds if driver pickup isn't confirmed in 8 minutes.
opportunities.target_user: Urban office workers and home businesses sending documents/parcels

ev_0001.text: Placed an order for medicines at 8 PM. App kept saying assigning partner for 70 minutes then abruptly cancelled. Terrible service now.
ev_0001.author: Pooja Hegde

ev_0002.text: No drivers anywhere in Indiranagar. Dunzo used to be the gold standard, now it is completely unusable.
ev_0002.author: Naveen K.

ev_0003.text: They deducted 450 rupees from UPI. Order was rejected but money sent to Dunzo cash instead of my bank account. Support chat is just an automated loop.
ev_0003.author: Sameer Khan

ev_0004.text: Still love the parcel service when it works. Sending forgotten keys or tiffin across town is irreplaceable.
ev_0004.author: Deepak M.

ev_0005.text: Dunzo faces operational restructuring and delayed vendor liabilities amid intense quick commerce competition from Blinkit and Zepto.
ev_0005.title: Quick commerce shifts landscape as legacy delivery apps restructure
ev_0005.author: Livemint
